# Instructions: Dongle ID Sharing on comma Connect

1. Ensure your comma device is connected to an active internet connection at all times (Wi-Fi is preferred; if using comma Prime, your own SIM, or connected to hotspot, ensure `Cellular Metered` is disabled under `Network -> Advanced`)
2. Share your device with me (https://connect.comma.ai/, gear icon, share by email, **sunnyhaibin@gmail.com** and **support@sunnypilot.ai**, share icon again to confirm), set the device name to your year/make/model and your Discord username so I can find it in the list.
3. Go to https://connect.comma.ai, select the desired route (fingerprints, issues, etc.), Files, find "All logs" -> click "upload x logs", then View upload queue, and confirm all raw logs are uploaded.
4. Once all raw logs are uploaded, click More info, turn on "Preserved" to preserve the route.
5. Post the route ID in this channel.

how are these models different than what comma shipped with 0.10? are they based of or entirely new ?

the non-technical answer is that the models are like AI babies, they are birthed and may share characteristics with previous models, but may also include improvements/regressions for some behaviors.  The models get names instead of numbers because they are new, but don't necessarily represent a "better revision".  The models also behave differently depending on vehicle and driving environment so reception amongst users is a mixed bag.

my general advice is to find your co-parent (someone with the same car) and see what model they like. Or try them all and figure out what behaviors are unacceptable for you (bad lane changes, hugging the lines, rolling through stop signs, stopping at green lights)  and filter that way.
